relations.meaning: Essays applies CyberAlchemy commitments while retaining a bounded product identity.
relations.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Essays Project owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Subproduct does not mean identical product or inherited implementation.

relations.meaning: The product is guided by its candidate thesis without the thesis proving realization.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Guidance is not thesis proof or automatic adoption.

relations.meaning: The Project coordinates development and evidence for the product without becoming the product.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Project membership does not achieve or own the product outcome.

relations.meaning: The Goal is durably coordinated by the Essays Project.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Belonging does not imply achievement.

relations.meaning: The first runtime Goal may test one bounded realization of the thesis but cannot prove the whole proposition.
relations.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus product evidence owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: A runtime PASS is not product-thesis proof.

relations.meaning: Essays is intended to reduce writing reconstruction burden while preserving writer control.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Intended service is not observed value or user adoption.

relations.meaning: Essays claims value through a reviewable, attributable writing outcome.
relations.forbidden_collapse: A claimed outcome is not measured value.

relations.meaning: Develop Governed Essay is a Product Capability owned by Essays.
relations.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus Essays Product Capability owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: The capability is not the whole product or its realization.

relations.meaning: The capability must enable the bounded reviewable-essay outcome.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Outcome production is a product contract, not implementation evidence.

relations.meaning: Whisper is the selected starting capability source and may partially realize Essays after an explicit binding and conformance decision.
relations.owner_route: Essays Product Capability owner plus Arcanum Whisper spell owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Source fit is not adoption, complete realization, conformance, or authority transfer.

relations.meaning: The capability consumes an explicit text-intent substrate rather than inferring complete author intent from a draft.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Consumption does not make the substrate complete or authoritative.

relations.meaning: The capability makes the construction plan inspectable before full drafting.
relations.forbidden_collapse: A plan is not a draft or execution authority.

relations.meaning: The capability produces version-identified draft artifacts.
relations.owner_route: Essay author plus Essays Product Capability owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Draft production is not acceptance or publication.

relations.meaning: The capability exposes addressable review state for author disposition.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Exposed feedback is not an accepted revision.

relations.meaning: Review records bind to stable draft locations and selected text.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Annotation is not mutation permission.

relations.meaning: Validation reports evaluate bounded properties of one draft version.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Evaluation does not promote editorial status or truth.

relations.meaning: The capability preserves unresolved editorial and workflow residue rather than hiding it.
relations.owner_route: Essay author plus affected claim owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Preservation does not resolve residue.

relations.meaning: The capability can produce a clean audience-facing export from a selected draft state.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Export is not publication or external delivery.

relations.meaning: An export retains the source draft identity while excluding authoring-only state.
relations.forbidden_collapse: A derived export does not replace the source draft.

relations.meaning: An owner-selected upstream substrate may inform bounded interaction and editor mechanics after review.
relations.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus license review owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Research, selection, or reuse does not transfer product meaning or architecture authority.

relations.meaning: Essays includes a bounded capability for inspecting its construction meaning without editing semantic authority.
relations.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus Essays Product Capability owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Including an inspection capability does not turn Essays into the ontology runtime or definitions authority.

relations.meaning: The capability must make the bounded product construction model understandable and navigable.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Producing an inspectable outcome is not proof that a person understood it or that the model is accepted.

relations.meaning: The capability produces one version-identified read-only projection from bound semantic sources.
relations.owner_route: Essays Product Capability owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 ontology owners
relations.forbidden_collapse: Projection production is not source mutation, registry ownership, or currentness beyond the bound epoch.

relations.meaning: The view groups definition bindings and candidates while retaining their distinct authority status.
relations.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 definitions-governance owner plus Essays Product Capability owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Grouping definitions does not promote candidates or duplicate definition authority.

relations.meaning: The view groups product identities relevant to Essays without collapsing products into projects or implementations.
relations.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Essays Project owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Grouping products does not prove their thesis or value.

relations.meaning: The view groups governed project identities and distinguishes them from filesystem and DomainSpec project representations.
relations.forbidden_collapse: Grouping projects does not authorize their goals or work.

relations.meaning: The view groups ontology identities by branch and claim ceiling without merging their authority scopes.
relations.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 ontology owners plus Essays Project owner
relations.forbidden_collapse: Grouping ontologies does not merge product, capability, or system truth.
